briefing: A parcel waits one jump out. A patrol sits on that route. It reads every hold it stops.
Keep the parcel aboard. Stay clean the whole way there. Land it clean. You become one of us.
This note carries no name until the end. {PATRON}.

run.arrive: Land the parcel at {TARGET} without a scan
run.success: The parcel landed at {TARGET} clean, and {PAY} was paid without question
run.fail: The parcel never reached {TARGET}, and {PAY} goes unpaid

dossier.lead: Someone who signs nothing wants a word again.

rumour.far: Pilots swap a name at the bar, then swear they never said it.
rumour.near: A note finds you again, unsigned, and it waits at the next dock.

dossier.news: Quiet channels still move parcels for pilots who ask no questions.

story.opening: On day {DAY}, the commander accepted a note that named no one.

closing.complete: By day {DAY}, the commander delivered the parcel to {WORLD}, and no scanner saw it.
closing.fail: By day {DAY}, the parcel never reached {WORLD}, and the note went silent.

run.success: The commander landed the parcel at {WORLD} on day {DAY}, unseen and unquestioned.
run.failed: The parcel never reached {WORLD}, and the deadline closed the job by day {DAY}.

dossier.title: One Of Us
